text:
Fellow designers,

the Kundalini campaign has just started on Verkami!

It’s gonna be a very short one, just two weeks, so don’t miss the chance to embark in this epic combat!

Link: https://vkm.is/kundalini

The game itself it’s pretty cheap but the shipping it’s rather expensive outside Spain, so check out the different options you have. I’m really sorry about that (the shipping prices), but there was no way around it. It’s probably gonna be a very short run so the prices go up both on the production and on the logistics side.

It’s almost a work of handcraft.

If you have any question regarding the game or the campaign, let me know here or in the Verkami page itself.

In the case of the participants of this contest I’m specially grateful to you all. You helped me taking the decision to go ahead and give the crowdfunding a try. A little bit intimidating to be honest, but let’s see how it goes...

Again, thanks to you all!

Iván
